items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: we stayed with a lovely lady in a rooming house, Mrs. Ardor.

ctx.x: Uh huh. So Irene and I packed up our stuff, and incidentally, another commentary on the times there, the economy of the time -- Jimmy Noone, I was playing
with him and making $25 a week --and Irene quit working after we got married, she didn't want to play any more so she just stayed home and we stayed with a lovely lady in a rooming house, Mrs. Ardor.
Ms. Ardor! Yeah. Keg was there.
